They therefore lack the complete source-backed constraint/default/semantic-consumer disposition required for REF-004.

groups.requiredMeaning: Distinguish the exported schema document from create/parse/read manual validation, including whether defaults are inserted and which read/write caller owns each failure.

Record the direct AJV routes for pipeline/e2e documents separately from provider manual version/shape checks; do not convert test fixtures or provider result construction into runtime execution proof.
Document source-schema-to-generated-validator authority, default behavior, and actual selected validation route without claiming validator generation or Prism deployment ran.

Give each declaration an explicit supported consumer or an explicit declared-but-no-proved-runtime-schema-reader status. Do not treat the manifest/type declaration as a runtime validator or infer telemetry delivery. runtime_log.v1 remains separately source-qualified through its actual diagnostic writers.

materialFindings.impact: The page’s present finite/bounded disclosure is accurate, but it confirms rather than repairs the original all-schema gap.

materialFindings.finding: schemas.md still carries its older bounded/currentness presentation. A new REF-004 result must be generated from current sealed authority inputs, not relabeled current by the successful field-pointer check.

originalWholeFeasibility.reason: The residual is a finite 22-schema, four-family authority problem, not a need for a universal schema parser, default-global-API success, or a review of all 274 files.
notSupported: Closing REF-004 from suffixes, pointer counts, current-declaration status, or package paths.
Calling fixtures, retained declarations, or documentation examples inactive without an explicit authority disposition.
Claiming runtime default insertion merely because a schema contains default.
Using Event/contract declaration references as live validation or delivery proof.

oneMinimalCoherentSuccessor.owner: Existing docs-schema-fields/schema-field-bindings plus schemas-reference rendering path
oneMinimalCoherentSuccessor.change: Extend the existing schema binding contract with an explicit authority disposition for every current-declaration schema not already covered by the qualified configuration, Event, Worker/CRD/chart, or named-companion route. The first required entries are the finite 22 paths above. Render a concise authority table in schemas.md linking schema, exact validator/manual consumer or explicit no-proved-reader state, default-insertion behavior, and source limit.
requiredProperties: Exact source identity and regular/canonical physical input for every authority record.
Schema pointer/version/dialect and direct consumer symbol or explicit declared-without-proved-reader status.
Default semantics: annotation-only, validator insertion, resolver insertion, manual fallback, or none.
Constraint semantics must preserve recursive/reference/branch limits and avoid treating TypeScript shapes as schema validation.
Current versus retained/fixture/documentation classification remains separate.
namedControls: Missing, duplicate, extra, or unbound current-declaration authority entry fails.
Changed schema, validator/manual consumer, registration, package export, or authority status fails before rendering.
A runtime/default/activation claim without its exact source consumer fails.
A declared-but-no-proved-reader telemetry entry must remain non-runtime; adding a false consumer fails.
Pipeline-test-gate AJV and manual-provider routes must remain distinct.
Prism generated-validator source/validator relationship must reject a substituted schema or generated validator.
Existing --schemas-only and docs-schema-fields checks remain required; no generic schema evaluator is introduced.
requiredAffectedReview: Source review of the 22 records and their listed natural owners only.
Affected generator/reference review for the new authority disposition table.
Fresh schemas reference generation/check, then independent practical Reader and Quality review.

openHistoricalFindings.disposition: Retained. They are neither evidence for nor a prerequisite to this bounded schema-authority completion unless an included authority route actually depends on them.

originalREF004Status.reason: Current artifacts are valuable and current, but the finite 22-schema semantic authority/consumer/default gap means the original all-schema criterion is not yet met.
originalREF004Status.nextAction: Author one bounded existing schema-authority successor for the four listed families, then perform affected Source/code review, guarded native/reference generation, Reader/Quality review, and a separate whole REF-004 decision.

limits: No acceptance from native currentness alone.
